about: The walks the handoff and README document, each with what it measured. Tools/walks.py runs them all as a check. A walk's numbers are the ones recorded when it was measured; change one only with the reason, in the CHANGELOG, that the world it walks through changed. Jump heights were re-recorded at 0.16.0, when a step of flight became exact: they rose by the Euler error the old integration lost (0.97 → 0.99 at the ground, 1.90 → 1.92 off the lift).
